title: not real jail
content: I read a good amount of dreams of people getting jailed or put in a time out or purgatory type waiting place for being too aware of the dream, so I can't say I'm not affected by this reddit. But I finally had one of those occurrences, I think, and it had a fun detail I thought you guys would like. Saturday night I can remember bits of my dream, I was definitely set in the usual grandma's house/rural area/forest area. The urban-rural fringe of mallworld lol. I kept realizing if i focused i could float, and that made me realize I'm probably dreaming. There were some creepy characters and some freaky tones, and a lil bit of vague gore, my usual super fun dream vibes 🥲 But before I woke up all I remembered was being in a small square room with rocky gray walls and a regular sized square window facing into the building instead of outside, I think it was covered. I'm sitting in the room and someone is guarding it outside, I get the feeling I was just brought there, feeling a little rebellious and frustrated, and just getting comfortable sitting down, and shifting the furniture to stare towards the window. Behind the furniture I moved it's written super clearly "This place isn't real" on the wall from a previous occupant. I read it out loud and it echoed through my head as I woke up. (This is a constant, the last sound clip of my dream always cycles over a few times like a broken record when I wake up.) I just thought that was really fun, if you like to believe our astral bodies are really drifting around out there and getting into trouble in another realm, I definitely pushed the boundaries too far and got put in time out and someone before me definitely wanted to leave a message for others. Idk, I think it's just my very creative brain but it's super fun regardless.
